mantras.title: Mooka Panchashati — Arya Shatakam (verse 1)
mantras.textOriginal:
कारणपरचिद्रूपा काञ्चीपुरसीम्नि कामपीठगता ।
काचन विहरति करुणा काश्मीरस्तबककोमलाङ्गलता ॥
mantras.transliteration:
kāraṇaparacidrūpā kāñcīpurasīmni kāmapīṭhagatā |
kācana viharati karuṇā kāśmīrastabakakomalāṅgalatā ||
mantras.meaning: A certain compassion — the supreme consciousness that is the cause of all — sports within the bounds of Kāñcīpura, seated on the Kāma-pīṭha: a tender vine whose limbs are soft as clusters of saffron flowers.
mantras.sourceText: Mūka Pañcaśatī (Mūka Kavi), Āryā Śatakam, verse 1

Mūka Kavi is traditionally a pre-modern Kāñcī ācārya — public domain.
